CREATE VIEW [Finance].[vw_CUS__GeneralLedgerDataAttribute] WITH SCHEMABINDING
AS
SELECT GeneralLedgerDataKey = [gld].GeneralLedgerDataKey, CompanyKey = [gld].CompanyKey, OrganizationKey = CASE WHEN [line].[LineType] IN ('WIP', 'ACR', 'GJL', 'AJL', 'RJL') THEN [line].[OrganizationKey] ELSE [header].[OrganizationHeaderKey] END, Attribute_LFO = CASE WHEN [Dissection].Attribute_LFO = '0' OR [Dissection].Attribute_LFO IS NULL THEN '' WHEN [header].ledgerCode = 'GL' THEN ISNULL(GLAttribute.Attribute_LFO, 'NAV') WHEN Attribute.Countrycode = [reportingBook].CountryCode THEN 'LOC' WHEN Attribute.Countrycode IS NOT NULL THEN 'FOR' ELSE 'NAV' END, Attribute_LFE = CASE WHEN [Dissection].Attribute_LFE = '0' OR [Dissection].Attribute_LFE IS NULL THEN '' WHEN [header].ledgerCode = 'GL' THEN ISNULL(GLAttribute.Attribute_LFE, 'NAV') WHEN Attribute.Countrycode = [reportingBook].CountryCode THEN 'LOC' WHEN Attribute.EconomicGrouping = 'EUN' THEN 'WEU' WHEN Attribute.Countrycode IS NOT NULL THEN 'OEU' ELSE 'NAV' END, Attribute_OCG = CASE WHEN [Dissection].Attribute_OCG = '0' OR [Dissection].Attribute_OCG IS NULL THEN '' WHEN [header].ledgerCode = 'GL' THEN ISNULL(GLAttribute.Attribute_OCG, 'NAV') ELSE ISNULL([CompanyData].Attribute_OCG, 'NAV') END, Attribute_ORG = CASE WHEN [Dissection].Attribute_ORG = '0' OR [Dissection].Attribute_ORG IS NULL THEN '' ELSE IIF([header].[LedgerCode] = 'GL', ISNULL([GLAttribute].Attribute_ORG, 'NAV'), ISNULL(Attribute.OrganizationCode, 'NAV')) END, Attribute_SPR = CASE WHEN [Dissection].Attribute_SPR = '0' OR [Dissection].Attribute_SPR IS NULL THEN '' WHEN [header].[LedgerCode] = 'GL' THEN ISNULL([GLAttribute].Attribute_SPR, 'NAV') WHEN IIF([glMovement].[TaxGLMovementKey] IS NOT NULL, [glMovement].TransactionTypeCode, [header].[TransactionTypeCode]) = 'CRD' OR ( [header].TransactionTypeCode IN ('DRC', 'DPY') AND [header].[TransactionBelongsToGroup] IS NOT NULL AND [header].IsCancelled = 1 ) THEN 'SPR' WHEN IIF([glMovement].[TaxGLMovementKey] IS NOT NULL, [glMovement].TransactionTypeCode, [header].[TransactionTypeCode]) IN ('INV', 'DRC', 'DPY') THEN 'SPS' ELSE 'NAV' END, Attribute_TIC = CASE WHEN [Dissection].Attribute_TIC = '0' OR [Dissection].Attribute_TIC IS NULL THEN '' WHEN [header].[LedgerCode] = 'GL' THEN ISNULL([GLAttribute].Attribute_TIC, 'NAV') WHEN [line].[TaxExtraRateNumerator] > 0 AND [line].[TaxRateKey] IS NOT NULL THEN 'ETI' WHEN [line].[TaxExtraRateNumerator] = 0 AND [line].[TaxRateKey] IS NOT NULL THEN 'STI' ELSE 'NAV' END, OriginalAttribute_LFO = CASE WHEN [Dissection].Attribute_LFO IS NULL THEN '' WHEN [header].ledgerCode = 'GL' THEN ISNULL(GLAttribute.Attribute_LFO, 'NAV') WHEN Attribute.Countrycode = [reportingBook].CountryCode THEN 'LOC' WHEN Attribute.Countrycode IS NOT NULL THEN 'FOR' ELSE 'NAV' END, OriginalAttribute_LFE = CASE WHEN [Dissection].Attribute_LFE IS NULL THEN '' WHEN [header].ledgerCode = 'GL' THEN ISNULL(GLAttribute.Attribute_LFE, 'NAV') WHEN Attribute.Countrycode = [reportingBook].CountryCode THEN 'LOC' WHEN Attribute.EconomicGrouping = 'EUN' THEN 'WEU' WHEN Attribute.Countrycode IS NOT NULL THEN 'OEU' ELSE 'NAV' END, OriginalAttribute_OCG = CASE WHEN [Dissection].Attribute_OCG IS NULL THEN '' WHEN [header].ledgerCode = 'GL' THEN ISNULL(GLAttribute.Attribute_OCG, 'NAV') ELSE ISNULL([CompanyData].Attribute_OCG, 'NAV') END, OriginalAttribute_ORG = CASE WHEN [Dissection].Attribute_ORG IS NULL THEN '' ELSE IIF([header].[LedgerCode] = 'GL', ISNULL([GLAttribute].Attribute_ORG, 'NAV'), ISNULL(Attribute.OrganizationCode, 'NAV')) END, OriginalAttribute_SPR = CASE WHEN [Dissection].Attribute_SPR IS NULL THEN '' WHEN [header].[LedgerCode] = 'GL' THEN ISNULL([GLAttribute].Attribute_SPR, 'NAV') WHEN IIF([glMovement].[TaxGLMovementKey] IS NOT NULL, [glMovement].TransactionTypeCode, [header].[TransactionTypeCode]) = 'CRD' OR ( [header].TransactionTypeCode IN ('DRC', 'DPY') AND [header].[TransactionBelongsToGroup] IS NOT NULL AND [header].IsCancelled = 1 ) THEN 'SPR' WHEN IIF([glMovement].[TaxGLMovementKey] IS NOT NULL, [glMovement].TransactionTypeCode, [header].[TransactionTypeCode]) IN ('INV', 'DRC', 'DPY') THEN 'SPS' ELSE 'NAV' END, OriginalAttribute_TIC = CASE WHEN [Dissection].Attribute_TIC IS NULL THEN '' WHEN [header].[LedgerCode] = 'GL' THEN ISNULL([GLAttribute].Attribute_TIC, 'NAV') WHEN [line].[TaxExtraRateNumerator] > 0 AND [line].[TaxRateKey] IS NOT NULL THEN 'ETI' WHEN [line].[TaxExtraRateNumerator] = 0 AND [line].[TaxRateKey] IS NOT NULL THEN 'STI' ELSE 'NAV' END, PostPeriodForReportingBook = IIF([PeriodMgm].Period IS NULL AND [ReportingBook].StartDate > Gld.PostDate, 100001, PeriodMgm.Period), PeriodManagementKey = [PeriodMgm].PeriodManagementKey, ReportingBookCode = [ReportingBook].ReportingBookCode, ReportingBookKey = [ReportingBook].ReportingBookKey, CompanyOfPeriodKey = [ReportingBook].CompanyOfPeriodKey, TranslatedCurrency = [ReportingBook].RX_NKCurrency, LocalCurrency = [ReportingBook].LocalCurrency, PostDate = gld.PostDate, GLAccountKey = gld.GLAccountKey, AlternateChartKey = [ReportingBook].AlternateChartKey, LocalAmount = gld.LocalBalance, TransactionCategory = IIF([header].[LedgerCode] = 'GL', [header].[TransactionCategory], ''), BranchKey = gld.BranchKey, DepartmentKey = gld.DepartmentKey FROM [Finance].[BAS__GeneralLedgerData] AS [gld] JOIN Finance.CUS__ReportingBookAndPeriodInfo reportingBook ON reportingBook.CompanyKey = gld.CompanyKey LEFT JOIN Finance.BAS__PeriodManagement [PeriodMgm] ON [PeriodMgm].CompanyKey = reportingBook.CompanyOfPeriodKey AND gld.PostDate BETWEEN [PeriodMgm].StartDate AND [PeriodMgm].EndDate LEFT JOIN [Finance].[BAS__GLTransactionHeader] AS [header] ON [header].[GLTransactionHeaderKey] = [gld].[GLTransactionHeaderKey] LEFT JOIN [Finance].[BAS__AccGLTransactionLine] AS [line] ON [line].[AccGLTransactionLineKey] = [gld].[AccGLTransactionLineKey] LEFT JOIN [Finance].[CUS__TaxGLMovementInfo] [glMovement] ON [glMovement].TaxGLMovementKey = gld.TaxGLMovementKey LEFT JOIN [Finance].[CUS__OrganizationCompanyData] AS [CompanyData] ON [CompanyData].CompanyKey = [gld].CompanyKey AND [CompanyData].OrganizationKey = ( CASE WHEN [line].[LineType] IN ('WIP', 'ACR', 'GJL', 'AJL', 'RJL') THEN [line].[OrganizationKey] ELSE [header].[OrganizationHeaderKey] END ) LEFT JOIN [Finance].[CUS__OrganizationForAttributes] Attribute ON Attribute.OrganizationKey = ( CASE WHEN [line].[LineType] IN ('WIP', 'ACR', 'GJL', 'AJL', 'RJL') THEN [line].[OrganizationKey] ELSE [header].[OrganizationHeaderKey] END ) LEFT JOIN Finance.CUS__TransactionLineDissectionAttribute AS [GLAttribute] ON [GLAttribute].[AccGLTransactionLineKey] = [gld].[AccGLTransactionLineKey] LEFT JOIN Finance.CUS__AlternateGLAccountDissection AS [Dissection] ON [Dissection].AlternateChartKey = [ReportingBook].AlternateChartKey AND [Dissection].GLAccountKey = [Gld].GLAccountKey
